content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (preferred-level redline, validated).**

- **§XXIV(c) (p0149)** barred any Licensee assignment without Licensor consent, with no affiliate or M&A carve-out, and placed no restriction whatsoever on Licensor assignment — failing even the fallback (no mutual successor right, notice mechanic, or reasonableness standard).
- **Article XX(a) (p0134)** automatically terminated the Agreement and all our licences on our Change of Control absent Licensor's officer-level consent, with Licensor deemed reasonable in refusing on competitive or subjective grounds — walk-away territory.

Two surgical operations: (1) replaced the Licensee prohibition sentence and the dangling "Section 13.4(a)" change-of-control carve-out with consent-free Affiliate/M&A-successor assignment plus a Licensor consent restriction (not unreasonably withheld, no assignment to our competitors), keeping the "void attempt" and successors-and-assigns sentences verbatim; (2) replaced the automatic change-of-control termination with an express statement that a Change of Control gives Licensor no termination right, retaining the CHANGE OF CONTROL definition relied on elsewhere. Article XXII's right of first refusal is a separate commercial term and was not double-flagged.
